fields.title: Messi Announces Retirement In Football
fields.content:
Lionel Messi has called time on his Argentina career. The Inter Miami star announced his international retirement in Monday.

Writing in an official statement on his Instagram account, Messi said: "After all this time since the final match, and after a great deal of thought, I want to announce to everyone that I have decided to retire from playing with the national team."

He added: "It was a painful decision and it still hurts me deep down, but I know the time has come. I swear to you that I always gave everything I had, not only during the recent years in which we won everything, but before that too, and I always fought and gave all I have for this shirt, to make you happy and to make you feel proud of being Argentinian through football."

"There is not much left, and the stages have started to come to an end, and this is one of them that hurts me a great deal," he continued. "I love, I have loved, and I will always love being with the national team. I have used up everything I had, and I have no more left to give, alongside the presence of a group of wonderful young players who deserve to get their chance."

Messi went on: "Thank you for all this love over 20 years. I will miss hearing your voices from inside the stadium so much, and now I will become one of you, always cheering and supporting the national team from the outside, in the good times and the bad, and especially in the difficult times."
fields.author: Ashif khan

fields.title: Barcelona complete deadline-day transfer for Arsenal forward Gabriel Jesus
fields.content:
Gabriel Jesus completed a transfer deadline day move from Arsenal to Barcelona on Tuesday on a three-year contract.The 29-year-old Brazil striker was part of Arsenal's Premier League title-winning squad last season after lifting four league crowns with Manchester City.

He joins Spanish champion Barcelona following the departure of Robert Lewandowski at the end of last season.

Jesus joined Arsenal in 2022 after six trophy-laden seasons at City. Despite enduring an injury-disrupted time at the Emirates Stadium, he was part of the squad that ended the London club's 22-year wait to be crowned English champion.

Jesus is the latest arrival in a busy transfer window for Barcelona, following deals for Anthony Gordon, Rodri, Joao Cancelo, Karim Adeyemi and Dominik Livakovic.
fields.author: Ashif khan

fields.title: ‘Not a stance for progressive Kerala’: CM Satheesan rejects Islamic cleric Kanthapuram’s remarks on women
fields.content:
THIRUVANATHAPURAM: Amid attempts by UDF constituent IUML to downplay Islamic scholar Kanthapuram AP Aboobacker Musliyar’s remarks on women, Chief Minister VD Satheesan strongly opposed the cleric’s position, stating that neither the government nor his party would support such views.

Satheesan said Kanthapuram’s assertion that great ruin would follow if women entered public platforms and that the Quran called for women to remain indoors was 'unacceptable'.

“We do not agree with that statement at all. Moreover, that is not a stance suited for a progressive Keralam. We cannot agree with that position in any manner whatsoever,” he told reporters in response to a query at a post-cabinet meet briefing on Wednesday. 

Describing the position as something suited to the 19th century, Satheesan said it had no place in the 21st century.

“Women are not people meant to live confined within four walls. Our progressive stance is that they must participate in all aspects of life and be part of the mainstream,” he said.

Satheesan also argued that Kanthapuram’s position was inconsistent with Islamic history and amounted to a misinterpretation of Islam.
fields.author: Ashif khan

fields.title: More than 110 rescued a week after Nepal deadly floods, army says
fields.content:
One hundred and nineteen people have been rescued using air resources in Nepal following deadly floods, a spokesperson for the country's army said.

It comes nearly a week after the disaster that hit both Nepal and neighbouring Tibet, killing more than 1,000 people, with more than 3,900 still missing.

A Nepali army spokesperson earlier said a British male was among those rescued, along with 118 Nepalese people, of whom 44 were female and 74 male.

Later on Tuesday, the British man, Alastair Chambers, told the Telegraph and PA Media he was not rescued and had travelled to the region to help with aid efforts.

The BBC has contacted the UK Foreign Office for comment.

On Tuesday, Foreign Office minister Lord Wood of Anfield confirmed 36 British people remain unaccounted for - an increase from the 33 previously reported.

More than 600 are workers believed to be trapped in a vast network of mud-filled tunnels at hydropower sites along Trishuli River are among the thousands who are still missing.

Nepalese Prime Minister Balendra Shah said on Monday that 279 people had been rescued from the sites.
fields.author: Hamza

fields.title: Ather Konarc Electric Scooter Available in Four Colours
fields.content:
The Ather Konarc is the most affordable model in the Ather lineup, and it is available in four distinct colours. Here we take a closer look at the shades to see which one makes more sense for you.
Majestic Grey

This is the most subtle shade in the lineup, featuring a dark grey finish overall. Ather has also added metallic badging above the DRL and on the body panel, and it doesn’t come off as too flashy. 

Quartz White

In contrast to the Majestic Grey, this colour scheme is the boldest, featuring a white finish overall. It features similar badging to the Majestic Grey. The headlight cowl features a black finish, and it contrasts well with the overall white finish.

Lumen Copper

This colour scheme features a copper finish overall, and it strikes a good balance between being flashy and being elegant. The copper finish and the metallic badging go well together. Similar to the Quartz White, it also features a black finish on the headlight cowl.

Celestial Gold

This colour scheme is the most elegant one out of the four, with an off-white/gold finish. Compared to the other colours, this shade stands out with a premium look. But overall, the colour scheme is more suited to riders who want a shade that feels more premium.
